international.title: High-security prisoner used soap to escape despite being handcuffed and chained to officer
international.summary: Exclusive: Inmate from HMP Manchester now back in custody after 13 hours on the run A prisoner from one of England and Wales’s most dysfunctional high-security jails is believed to have used soap to help escape from officers while visiting a hospital for treatment. The 36-year-old detained at HMP Manchester managed to slip away despite being cuffed and chained to an officer, sources told the Guardian. He is believed to have lathered his metal cuff with liquid soap and slipped his hand out while being given privacy to use a bathroom. Continue reading...
